riddles.zh: 明明亮亮，又平又光。谁来看它，它都一样。
riddles.en: Bright and smooth, both flat and shiny. Whoever comes to look, it looks the same to all.

riddles.zh: 名字不同，高矮不同。五个兄弟，住在一起。
riddles.en: Different names, different heights. Five brothers, all living together.

riddles.zh: 明又明，亮又亮，一团火球挂天上。冬天呆得时间短，夏天呆得时间长。
riddles.en: Bright and bright, shining and bright, a ball of fire hangs in the sky. It stays briefly in winter, and stays long in summer.

riddles.zh: 小娃娃，圆又圆。夏天（热得…）挂在天中间。
riddles.en: A little doll, round and round. In summer (hot…), it hangs in the middle of the sky.

riddles.zh: 一根小木棍，按个弯月亮。秋天收庄稼，请它来帮忙。
riddles.en: A little wooden stick with a curved moon mounted on it. When the autumn harvest comes, you ask it to help.

riddles.zh: 屋子方方，有门没窗。屋外热烘，屋内冰凉。
riddles.en: A square little house, with a door but no window. Outside it's hot, inside it's icy cold.

riddles.zh: 住在水中央，四面水光。盐到水中，无影无踪。
riddles.en: Living in the middle of the water, shimmering water-light all around. Once salt drops into the water, it vanishes without a trace.

riddles.zh: 一个娃娃冬天生，全身上下冰冷冷。你叫它也不吭声，太阳一出就化水。
riddles.en: A doll born in winter, its whole body cold and icy. Call it and it never answers; the moment the sun comes out, it melts into water.

riddles.zh: 用手拿不起，用刀切不开。煮饭和洗衣，都得请我来。
riddles.en: You can't pick it up with your hands, you can't cut it with a knife. For cooking and washing, you must ask me for help.

riddles.zh: 一间屋子四方方，没有门来没有窗。里面暖和又明亮／亮亮又亮光，一天到晚亮光光／变花样。
riddles.en: A square little house, with no door and no window. Inside it's warm and bright / bright and shiny, glowing or changing patterns all day long.
